title: reduceByKey 与 groupByKey 的 shuffle 数据量对比
expected_output:
记录总数 = 12, 不同 key 数 = 6
groupByKey 全量搬运: shuffle 记录数 = 12
reduceByKey map端预聚合后搬运: shuffle 记录数 = 6
reduceByKey 减少 shuffle 量 = 6 条 (约 50%)
code:
from collections import Counter
def dhash(s):
    h = 0
    for c in s:
        h = (h * 31 + ord(c)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h
keys = ["a", "a", "a", "b", "b", "c", "d", "d", "d", "d", "e", "f"]
num_reduce = 4
gbk_shuffle = len(keys)
cnt = Counter(keys)
rbk_shuffle = len(cnt)
print(f"记录总数 = {len(keys)}, 不同 key 数 = {len(cnt)}")
print(f"groupByKey 全量搬运: shuffle 记录数 = {gbk_shuffle}")
print(f"reduceByKey map端预聚合后搬运: shuffle 记录数 = {rbk_shuffle}")
saved = gbk_shuffle - rbk_shuffle
print(f"reduceByKey 减少 shuffle 量 = {saved} 条 (约 {100 * saved // gbk_shuffle}%)")
